definition.description: A key visual is a central image that represents a topic or subject area and has a high recognition value.
definition.intended_role: A striking cover image across various media formats.

rights_and_usage.requirement: Only use motifs for which image rights or usage rights are available.

core_principles: Use a central, recognizable visual motif.
Design for long-term recognition rather than short-lived decorative use.
Ensure the visual can work as a cover or hero image in multiple media formats.
Follow Bosch image style or Bosch illustration style.
Use Bosch Sans when typography is included.

design_elements.rule: A photograph or illustration serves as the main motif.
A Bosch accent color can be selected for an additional text box.
Text is always set in Bosch Sans Bold or Regular.
A signet can be placed additionally if required.

illustration.rule: Use the Bosch illustration style when the key visual is illustration-based.

mandatory: Key visuals must correspond to Bosch image style or Bosch illustration style.
If text is used, it must be set in Bosch Sans Regular or Bosch Sans Bold.
Image or usage rights must be available for the motif.
prohibited: Pure product illustrations as key visuals.
Gradients and small graphics used as key visual style elements.
Abstract or graphic motifs that do not correspond to Bosch style.
Icon and signet type solutions that do not correspond to Bosch style.
Gradients in collage or style-mix contexts.

before_and_after_examples.section_purpose: Shows already created key visuals that are not Bosch-compliant, alongside optimized Bosch-compliant versions for comparison.

examples.do: Use a thematically appealing motif in Bosch image style with integrated text in Bosch Sans Regular and Bosch Sans Bold.
examples.dont: Do not use gradients and small graphics, and people as cutouts.

examples.do: Use a striking solution with Bosch icons, typography, accent colors, and individual signet creation from parts of Bosch Sans Regular and Bosch Sans Bold.
examples.dont: Do not use abstract and graphic motifs, colors, icon solutions, or signet type solutions that do not correspond to the Bosch style.

examples.do: Use a free design with Bosch typography in mixed font, icon, and accent color. Single images can be included in circles.
examples.dont: Do not use clipping and collage style mixes and gradients.

framing.guideline: A key visual should be designed with its main message in mind so that it can function flexibly in different media formats, such as print and web, and in landscape and portrait formats.
framing.design_intent: Prioritize the main message and adaptability across formats.

technical_requirements.image_production: For image production, basic technical requirements for data creation and delivery must be met.
technical_requirements.image_and_film_production: For image and film productions, basic technical requirements for data creation and delivery must be met.

must_include_when_creating_key_visual: Central motif with high recognition value
Saturated, lively visual atmosphere when photo-based
Bosch Sans Regular or Bold for text
Adaptability to landscape and portrait formats
